pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa pūgassa pariveṇavāsikā bhikkhuniyo yāguyā kilamanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.3: athakho so pūgo bhikkhunīnaṃ yāguatthāya chandakaṃ saṅgharitvā aññatarassa āpaṇikassa ghare parikkhāraṃ nikkhipitvā bhikkhuniyo upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.4: amukassa ayye āpaṇikassa ghare yāguatthāya parikkhāro nikkhitto
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.5: tato taṇḍule āharāpetvā yāguṃ pacāpetvā paribhuñjathāti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.6: bhikkhuniyo tena ca parikkhārena sayaṃpi yācitvā bhesajjaṃ cetāpetvā paribhuñjiṃsu.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.7: so pūgo jānitvā ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.8: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessantīti. assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa pūgassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa. yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.12: hi nāma bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.14: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:1.15.1: yā pana bhikkhunī aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpeyya nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:2.12: yaṃ atthāya dinnaṃ taṃ ṭhapetvā aññaṃ cetāpeti payoge dukkaṭaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:2.14: nissajjitabbaṃ saṅghassa vā gaṇassa vā ekabhikkhuniyā vā.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:2.17: idaṃ me ayye aññadatthikena parikkhārena aññuddisikena mahājanikena saññācikena aññaṃ cetāpitaṃ nissaggiyaṃ
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:2.22.1: aññadatthike aññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:2.23: aññadatthike vematikā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np9:2.24: aññadatthike anaññadatthikasaññā aññaṃ cetāpeti nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
